scripts.model:typecheck: quint typecheck models/main.qnt && quint typecheck models/retro/reconciler.qnt && for f in models/board/*/*.qnt; do quint typecheck $f || exit 1; done && quint typecheck models/intent/main.qnt && quint typecheck models/intent/alphabet.qnt && for f in models/intent/scenarios/*.qnt; do quint typecheck $f || exit 1; done && python3 models/helpers/intent-pairing.py
scripts.model:test: quint test models/main.qnt --main=main && quint test models/retro/reconciler.qnt --main=retro && quint test models/intent/main.qnt --main=intent_main && for f in models/intent/scenarios/*.qnt; do quint test $f --main=$(basename $f .qnt) || exit 1; done
scripts.model:simulate: quint run models/main.qnt --main=main --invariant=stateInvariants --max-steps=40 --max-samples=200 && quint run models/intent/alphabet.qnt --main=intent_alphabet --invariant=intentInvariants --max-steps=8 --max-samples=300
